_comment: Merge the 'hooks' block below into your .claude/settings.json. Seven hooks:
PreToolUse       -> spec_gate.py            block a delegation whose spec lacks the ten headings
Stop             -> output_rules_guard.py   check the final message against rules/output_rules.json
Stop             -> handoff_stop.py         ask for a handoff at the soft (90k) and hard (150k) lines
SessionStart     -> memory_lint.py          audit the memory index; silent when clean
SessionStart     -> handoff_sessionstart.py list the live handoff tracks
PostToolUse      -> prose_rule_guard.py     ask whether a rule being written as prose could be a check
UserPromptSubmit -> output_rules_preflight.py  inject the rules you broke in the last 7 days
$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is expanded by Claude Code, which is how every path here stays relative.
Replace 'python' with a full interpreter path if the one you want is not on PATH.
Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.

env._comment: All optional. Delete the ones you do not need; the defaults are described in the README.
